mapper.sql: d.id,d.publisher_id,d.application_id,d.target_instance_id,d.environment,d.service_principal,d.owner_principal,d.issuer,d.subject,d.client_id,d.status,d.version, to_char(d.valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') valid_until,d.command_id,d.reason, to_char(d.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') created_at, to_char(d.disabled_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') disabled_at,d.valid_until>clock_timestamp() unexpired
mapper.select: SELECT target_instance_id,environment FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_target WHERE singleton=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.catalog_publisher_target(target_instance_id,environment,created_by,reason) VALUES(#{target.targetInstanceId},#{target.environment},#{operator},#{reason}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT operator_principal,payload_hash,result_json FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_event WHERE application_id=#{app} AND command_id=#{command}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation d WHERE d.application_id=#{app} ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation d WHERE d.application_id=#{app} AND d.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation d WHERE d.application_id=#{app} AND d.publisher_id=#{publisher}

SELECT FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation d JOIN auth_governance.login_identity li ON li.issuer=d.issuer AND li.subject=d.subject AND li.principal_id=d.service_principal JOIN auth_governance.principal s ON s.id=d.service_principal AND s.kind='SERVICE' AND s.status='ACTIVE' JOIN auth_governance.principal o ON o.id=d.owner_principal AND o.kind='HUMAN' AND o.status='ACTIVE' JOIN auth_governance.application_catalog a ON a.application_id=d.application_id AND a.owner_principal_id=d.owner_principal JOIN auth_governance.catalog_publisher_target t ON t.target_instance_id=d.target_instance_id AND t.environment=d.environment WHERE d.publisher_id=#{slot.publisherId} AND d.application_id=#{slot.applicationId} AND d.target_instance_id=#{slot.targetInstanceId} AND d.environment=#{slot.environment} AND d.service_principal=#{slot.servicePrincipal} AND d.issuer=#{slot.tokenAuthority.issuer} AND d.subject=#{slot.subject} AND d.client_id=#{slot.tokenAuthority.clientId} AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND d.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND CAST(#{expiresAt} AS timestamptz)>clock_timestamp() FOR SHARE OF d,li,s,o,t
SELECT CAST(#{until} AS timestamptz)>clock_timestamp() AND CAST(#{until} AS timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 days'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation(id,publisher_id,application_id,target_instance_id,environment,service_principal,owner_principal,issuer,subject,client_id,valid_until,command_id,reason) VALUES(#{id},#{slot.publisherId},#{slot.applicationId},#{slot.targetInstanceId},#{slot.environment},#{slot.servicePrincipal},#{owner},#{slot.tokenAuthority.issuer},#{slot.subject},#{slot.tokenAuthority.clientId},CAST(#{until} AS timestamptz),#{command},#{reason}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation SET status='DISABLED',version=2,disabled_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE application_id=#{app} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_preview WHERE preview_id=#{preview} AND application_id=#{app} AND delegation_id=#{delegation})

SELECT r.version FROM auth_governance.catalog_release r JOIN auth_governance.catalog_publisher_release p ON p.application_id=r.application_id AND p.version=r.version WHERE r.application_id=#{app} AND r.command_id=#{command} AND p.delegation_id=#{delegation}

SELECT 'SERVICE' kind,p.service_principal,p.owner_principal,p.delegation_id,d.publisher_id,p.target_instance_id,p.environment FROM auth_governance.catalog_publisher_release p JOIN auth_governance.catalog_publisher_delegation d ON d.id=p.delegation_id WHERE p.application_id=#{app} AND p.version=#{version}
